contexts.text: They put on Delights still more interior.
That He would put on celestial and thus Divine things.
Lot put on another representation.
Thus are goods and truths put on.
The Lord putting on the Divine. AC 2010. AC 2063. AC 2112. AC 2216. AC 2218. AC 2624.
He shall be clothed in white raiment.
That the Divine... should put on something natural. (AC 2162.) And that the Human should put on the Celestial. Signified. The Celestial and derivative Spiritual which He put on. Signified.
That He would put off human rational truth, and would put on truth Divine. Signified.
Truth is the clothing of good; therefore truths are called clothes, and garments.
When the Angels appear clothed, it is the resplendence inducing the appearance of a garment.
In its place He put on the Human Divine. AC 2288:end.
The Actual of the parents puts on nature.
It pleased Him to put on the human like another man.
Raiment () = the Lord's Human.
Clothed in a vesture...
Clothed in clean white linen.
Why He put on the human state itself...
The puttings on of various states by the Lord. (Explained.)
Truth then clothes the man...
That good has been clothed with truth. Signified.
He shall wash his clothing in wine (). Clothing, here, = the Divine Natural.
Before He put on Divine good and truth as to the natural man also.
She put them on Jacob () = to communicate and imbue...
Garment to put on () = to be appropriated and conjoined...
When the Lord had put on the Divine Esse.
The putting on of the Divine as to the Human. Signified.
To be purified from sins, by... the putting on of the Lord's justice. Signified.
Clothed in white. Explained.
To change the garments = to put on holy truths. Illustrated.
Putting off the old man, and putting on the new.
Clothing of camel's hair = the Word, such as is its literal sense as to truth; which sense is a clothing for the internal sense.
Clothed... for use in a lower sphere...
That which gives the clothing is the mother; for the clothing is the body of that soul.
Spirits put on all things of the man's memory, etc. AC 5859. AC 5860. SE 267.
The Lord put on that same which was with the (Celestial) Angels...
(Such) appear clothed in white.
They appear clothed in azure...
The clothing (of the inhabitants of Jupiter).
The infinite (must) put on something finite...
(Not) a man clothed in soft clothings (). Explained.
Clothing, or garment, said of the Word, = the truth Divine there in the ultimate form.
There, all appear clothed according to the truths from good.
To clothe one's self () = to teach truths of doctrine.
The clothing (of a woman of the First Earth). The same served the man also for clothing.
All clothings derive their signification from the part of the body which they cover. AC 9916:end.
Thou shalt put them on Aaron () = to induce the state which is represented by the garments...
Why He clothed His Divine with the Human...
All things in the world come forth from the Divine, and are clothed with such things in nature...
Uses are clothed with such things...
On the garments with which the Angels appear clothed. Chapter.
The infants are not clothed with an earthly body...
Whatever is confirmed puts on the appearance of truth.
He then puts on a spiritual body... (For) the bodies with which the Angels are clothed are spiritual.
The Lord put on this third degree by the assumption of the Human. DLW 234.
Uses created for the clothing of the body...
Clothing as applied to the truths of wisdom.
The Angels are clothed gratis...
The muscles make a clothing.
Every man (then) puts off the material body, and puts on a spiritual one.
White vestments that thou mayest be clothed () = to acquire genuine truths of wisdom.
The woman was clothed with crimson and scarlet (). Explained.
The Angel was clothed in...
The bridegroom was clothed in... CL 21, Explained.
The material man is as the clothing to (the spiritual or substantial man).
a. [end]. The putting off of the External, and the putting on of the Internal, after death. Explained.
The clothing of the offspring is from the mother. Explained.
That the Spiritual clothes itself with the Natural, as man does with a garment. Explained.
That spiritual things thus clothed in man cause that...
His soul is then clothed with a substantial body, as in the world it had been clothed with a material body.
The Lord (then) put on the Divine Natural.
Man puts on a totally different state if...
When the material body has been taken away, and the... clothing of the spirit has been thus removed...

Man is born spiritual as to the soul, and is clothed with the Natural which makes his material body; and therefore when this is laid aside, his soul, clothed with a spiritual body, comes into (that) World.
By the putting on of a specious appearance...
The Spirits put on the man himself. Explained.
Certain Spirits do not at once put on the man's memory; some put on all of it. Explained.
All clothings = things which proceed. Explained.
To put on (or be clothed) () = to acquire intelligence. AE 246.
After this last temptation, He put on the Divine good of the Divine love...
Clothed in white robes = in truths.
When man puts off his material body, he puts on a spiritual one, with which he rises.

Nor for your body, what ye shall put on... Is not the body more than clothing? ()... To clothe the body, and the clothing, = the truth which invests the good of love... The clothing = that truth; and the body, the good of the will.
To be clothed = to be in externals; for the clothes are external things which cover; hence to be clothed = the appearance in externals.
A clothing from the sun of the world, is given to the things which are in the natural world.
